description: This Java source file defines a Jersey provider class 'JerseyJacksonObjectArgumentHandler' that handles JSON serialization and deserialization for HTTP message bodies using Spring's Jackson converter. It supports reading and writing JSON objects and strings in a JAX-RS environment.
